categories.main_business_segments: Suzhou Zelgen Biopharmaceuticals Co., Ltd. focuses on innovative drug research, development, production, and sales in oncology, bleeding and hematological diseases, and immune-inflammatory diseases. The company has developed and commercialized small molecule targeted drugs and complex recombinant protein biologics, including marketed products like Donafenib and recombinant human thrombin, and has multiple clinical-stage innovative drugs in its pipeline.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes two core technology platforms: a small molecule drug R&D and industrialization platform, and a complex recombinant protein biologics and antibody drug R&D and industrialization platform. It employs advanced technologies such as gene recombination, protein engineering, fermentation engineering, and antibody engineering. Manufacturing facilities comply with GMP standards for oral solid formulations and recombinant protein drugs, while chemical APIs are outsourced to qualified manufacturers.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are hospitals, pharmacies, and healthcare providers in China, with products targeting patients suffering from advanced liver cancer, thyroid cancer, hematological malignancies, autoimmune diseases, and bleeding disorders. The company’s marketed drugs are included in the national medical insurance catalog, facilitating patient access. The company also collaborates with distributors and exclusive marketing partners for product promotion and sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with its headquarters and production facilities located in Kunshan, Jiangsu Province. It has subsidiaries in Shanghai, Zhejiang, Hong Kong, and a significant R&D center in California, USA (GENSUN). The marketed products and clinical trials primarily target the Chinese market, while several pipeline drugs have FDA clinical trial approvals, indicating plans for global market expansion.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zelgen operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the pharmaceutical supply chain, focusing on drug R&D, manufacturing of finished pharmaceutical products, and commercialization. It outsources chemical API production to qualified suppliers but controls formulation manufacturing and commercial sales. The company also licenses marketing rights to partners for certain products.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in oncology, bleeding, hematological, and immune-inflammatory diseases, focusing on best-in-class and first-in-class small molecule targeted drugs and multi-specific antibody biologics. It emphasizes global R&D coordination, expanding clinical indications, and accelerating commercialization. Key R&D initiatives include JAK inhibitors, bispecific and trispecific antibodies, and novel small molecules targeting KRAS mutations and TLR8 agonists.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of proprietary drugs such as Donafenib and recombinant human thrombin. The company also earns licensing fees from exclusive marketing agreements, such as the partnership with Penglai Nuokang for recombinant human thrombin. Additional income sources include government subsidies and investment income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Zelgen positions itself as an innovative biopharmaceutical company with a differentiated product pipeline in China’s competitive oncology and autoimmune drug markets. It competes with domestic and international pharmaceutical companies developing targeted therapies and biologics. The company’s unique multi-specific antibody platforms and first-in-class small molecule drugs provide competitive advantages in emerging therapeutic areas.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 532.95 million, a 37.91% increase year-over-year, driven mainly by increased sales of Donafenib. Despite ongoing losses due to high R&D investment, net losses narrowed compared to prior years. The company has total assets of about RMB 3 billion and continues to invest heavily in R&D, with a 72.8% R&D-to-revenue ratio in 2024, reflecting a growth-oriented profile focused on innovation and commercialization.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zelgen emphasizes developing innovative drugs with independent intellectual property rights that are safe, effective, and affordable. Its products, such as Donafenib, are included in national treatment guidelines and insurance catalogs, enhancing accessibility. The company’s multi-specific antibody platforms and novel small molecule drugs target unmet clinical needs, offering differentiated therapeutic options with potential best-in-class efficacy and safety profiles.
